description_en: Disassociates a Virtual Border Router (VBR) from an Express Connect circuit
kebab_example: aliyun vpc unassociate-physical-connection-from-virtual-border-router --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-id vbr-bp16ksp61j7e0tkn00000 --physical-connection-id pc-bp1qrb3044eqixog0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassociatePhysicalConnectionFromVirtualBorderRouter

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VBR to disassociate from the Express Connect circuit
parameters.help_zh: 要与物理专线解绑的VBR的实例ID
parameters.name: vbr_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
